defects_tracked.description: Campaign Network Graph renders as closely threaded beads / dense hairball without cluster separation, dynamic hub aggregation, or entity search, degrading forensic legibility. Cap slices array head without sort or diversity, introducing selection bias at scale.
Synthetic pseudo-entities (e.g. person:csv-import@unknown.local at degree 214) distort graph topology; aggregation layer must collapse or badge synthetic import provenance entities distinctly.

At corpus scale, the campaign graph correlates the top-1,000 emails ordered by threat severity and recency. This selection window must be explicitly disclosed in the UI banner rather than remaining silent.
Client-side entity search, highlight, and multi-dimensional filter (promoted from deferred to v1.2.0 graph redesign).
